versions.subject: feat: fix issues and fp filters
versions.detection:
selection_path:
    Image|endswith: '\rundll32.exe'
    CommandLine|contains:
        - '%LOCALAPPDATA%'
        - '\AppData\Local\'
selection_extensions:
    - CommandLine|contains: '.dat",'
    - CommandLine|endswith:
        - '.dll #1'
        - '.dll" #1'
        - '.dll",#1'
filter_main_exclude_temp:
    CommandLine|contains: '\AppData\Local\Temp\'
condition: all of selection_* and not 1 of filter_main_*
versions.spl: Image="*\\rundll32.exe" CommandLine IN ("*%LOCALAPPDATA%*", "*\\AppData\\Local\\*") CommandLine="*.dat\",*" OR CommandLine IN ("*.dll #1", "*.dll\" #1", "*.dll\",#1") NOT CommandLine="*\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\*"
